latest.title: T pauses
latest.notes: Press T to pause and resume: the game, its clock and the music stand still, and the run continues exactly where it stopped.

versions.title: Stacked courses, instant restart, music, rainbow
versions.notes: Before track shaping: Courses, R restart, music, rainbow, ad-free scene.

versions.title: Gravity modes (curves and ramps)
versions.notes: Sideways-gravity curves and airborne ramp effects, before the course itself was reshaped.

versions.title: Track shaping with rigid blocks
versions.notes: Curves and 90-degree twists built one 14-unit block at a time; the last version before the three-slab geometry. Score/speed-up trigger boxes repaired on 2026-10-22 (they missed the ball in every build since the spawner patch).

versions.title: Three-slab geometry (first build)
versions.notes: Lane blocks as three slabs with per-slab roll. Known bad: slabs sat one slab late (lane ends 9.4 short of each jump/drop) and the score triggers missed the ball (no score, void after the start tunnel).

versions.title: Section-start wrap, version picker, stack on straight only
versions.notes: Added the two extra slabs at each section start and the Version selector. Known bad: lane still ended 9.4 short at section ends; score triggers still missed the ball.

versions.title: Forward slab placement, score triggers repaired
versions.notes: Slabs cover the block ahead of the spawn point (vanilla spans), score/speed-up triggers hit the ball again. Last incremental-roll geometry before the continuous roll rework.

versions.title: Compressed data bundle, loader cache
versions.notes: Same play as v9-forward; the scene bundle is gzip-compressed and the loader keeps the build in IndexedDB. Known bad: stacked courses (and the game-over screen) could abort the runtime (abort(218)) a few seconds after a lap spawn burst or a death, from the mod's stray heap writes; fixed in the next version.

versions.title: Freeze fix, gzip bundle
versions.notes: Heap writes limited to the real FSM variable objects (the random freezes), data bundle gzip-wrapped for a faster load. Last version with incremental (per-block) roll geometry.

versions.title: Continuous roll
versions.notes: Twists and curves as real helicoid geometry (one block per spawner step); the last version with the compile-time rainbow shader rewrite.

versions.title: Shader styles, continuous roll
versions.notes: Post-processing shader styles (Rainbow, Neon glow, Synthwave, CRT, Hyperspeed, Pixel, Noir, Matrix) on the helicoid continuous-roll geometry. Known bad: a ball wedged between stacked courses at a section drop sat still forever (fixed in the next version by the stuck-ball watchdog).

versions.title: Stuck-ball watchdog
versions.notes: Shader styles plus the wedged-run watchdog; the last version before the Sunny / Night light modes.

versions.title: Light modes
versions.notes: Normal, Sunny and Night lighting on top of the shader styles, the continuous roll and the stuck-ball watchdog.

versions.title: Music figures: zombie horde and Mort crowd
versions.notes: Skyline pillars become a zombie horde with Aria Math and a crowd of Morts with Mort Jackson. Last version before the password-locked dev mode.

versions.title: Dev mode
versions.notes: Password-locked Claude Code editing of the page from the Pi, on top of the light modes and the music figures. Known bad: the title menu is hidden under the sky with Light = Sunny or Night (fixed in the next version).

versions.title: Light modes, menu fixed
versions.notes: The game's menu stays visible over the sky. Known bad: the lit modes' light shafts never rendered (fixed in the next version).

versions.title: Light modes, review fixes
versions.notes: Light shafts and GL-state review fixes. Last version before the downloaded Mort model and the HUD/editor keyboard and music-lifetime fixes.

versions.title: Mort model and runtime fixes
versions.notes: Downloaded Mort model with original colors, corrected HUD/editor shortcuts and music-source lifetime. Before startup reset-loop protection.

versions.title: Starting-tunnel reset protection
versions.notes: Startup grace in seconds, no false stuck resets after delayed frames, and no stack rebuild loop from late music confirmations. Before the denser Mort crowd and King Julien obstacles.

versions.title: More Morts and King Julien blocks
versions.notes: 87 low-poly Morts per skyline chunk, King Julien PNGs on red obstacles during Mort Jackson, and immediate restoration with other music. Before the accurate textured Mort V2 replacement.

versions.title: Accurate textured Mort V2
versions.notes: 87 original textured Mort V2 models, transparent fur cards and slope-aligned placement; King Julien blocks retained. Before the twist/roll camera-frame fix.

versions.title: Locked twist camera and inward-facing Morts
versions.notes: Camera follows twists and rolls; Mort crowds stand equally far from both sides and turn 20 degrees inward.

versions.title: Dev mode (password-locked Claude Code editing)
versions.notes: Type devmode on the page; with the password, Claude Code edits the page from a sandbox on the owner's Pi within a token share, freezing the version it replaces. Courses still limited to a straight track here.

versions.title: Courses stack on curves and twists
versions.notes: Stacking allowed on Curves/Twists as an experiment, dev mode, shader review fixes, textured Mort crowd and King Julien obstacles.

versions.title: Versions in order
versions.notes: Snapshots numbered in the order they were live. Known gap: the creeping-ball rule described in c757516 was not in the code (fixed in the next version).

versions.title: Creeping-ball watchdog
versions.notes: Stuck-ball watchdog also restarts a ball creeping under 5 units/s; last version before the T pause key.
